scope: Listed U.S. and Hong Kong companies whose primary revenue comes from optical communications, optical interconnect, optical networking, optical fiber/cable, or closely related photonics used for data/telecom connectivity.

qualification.strict: Optical-connectivity revenue is explicitly >50% of consolidated revenue, or filings describe the continuing business as essentially a single optical/fiber-connectivity business and do not disclose a material non-optical business.
qualification.broad: A >50% disclosed segment is dominated by optical/photonics products but the segment also includes adjacent products, so the exact optical-only share is not separately disclosed.
qualification.watch: Optical exposure is meaningful but is <=50% or the latest filing does not disclose enough information to verify >50%.

companies.name: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc.
companies.basis: The company describes its products as fiber-optic networking products. FY2025 revenue was 53.8% CATV, 42.9% data center, 3.0% telecom and 0.3% FTTH/other; these markets are served by its optical devices, modules and equipment.

companies.name: Lumentum Holdings Inc.
companies.basis: Cloud & Networking revenue was $1,410.8M of $1,645.0M total revenue. FY2026 changed to one reportable segment, so FY2025 is the latest directly comparable disclosed split.

companies.name: Fabrinet
companies.basis: Optical communications revenue was $2,468.2M of $3,325.3M total revenue in the first nine months of FY2026.

companies.name: Ciena Corporation
companies.basis: Optical Networking represented 70.0% of Q2 FY2026 revenue; FY2025 Optical Networking was $3,246.2M of $4,769.5M (68.1%).
companies.source: Ciena FY2026 Q2 results; FY2025 Form 10-K

companies.name: Clearfield, Inc.
companies.basis: Continuing operations are reported as one segment focused on fiber management, protection and delivery products for broadband networks. The filing does not separately disclose an optical-only percentage.

companies.name: Coherent Corp.
companies.basis: Datacenter & Communications revenue was $5,274.6M of $7,118.2M total revenue. The segment is dominated by transceivers, lasers and optical components, but the company does not disclose an optical-only percentage inside the segment.

companies.name: Optical Cable Corporation
companies.basis: The company sells both fiber-optic and copper cabling/connectivity products; the filing does not disclose a fiber-versus-copper revenue split sufficient to verify >50% optical revenue.

companies.name: 中际旭创 / Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd.
companies.basis: Optical communication transceiver module revenue was RMB37,456.5M of RMB38,239.9M total revenue.
companies.source: Zhongji Innolight FY2025 Annual Report / H-share prospectus

companies.name: 海光芯正 / Crealights Technology Co., Ltd.
companies.basis: Optical transceiver modules were 75.7% of FY2025 revenue and active optical cables (AOC) were 20.3%, totaling 96.0%.

companies.name: 曦智科技 / Lightelligence Holdings Co., Ltd.
companies.basis: Optical interconnect products accounted for 79.2% of FY2025 revenue; optical computing products accounted for the remaining 20.8%.

companies.name: 长飞光纤光缆 / Yangtze Optical Fibre and Cable Joint Stock Limited Company
companies.basis: Revenue attributed to the optical communications industry was RMB13,986.7M of RMB14,252.1M total revenue.

companies.name: 南方通信 / Nanfang Communication Holdings Limited
companies.basis: Optical fiber cables were RMB427.8M and optical distribution network devices RMB26.1M of RMB464.2M total revenue, totaling 97.79%.

companies.name: 高科桥光导科技 / Transtech Optelecom Science Holdings Limited
companies.basis: FY2025 revenue was HK$88.869M optical fibre cables, HK$5.414M optical fibres and HK$1.951M other optical-related products, totaling HK$96.234M.
companies.source: Transtech Optelecom Science FY2025 Annual Report

companies.name: 剑桥科技 / CIG Shanghai Co., Ltd.
companies.basis: High-speed optical module revenue was RMB1,675.4M of RMB4,823.4M total revenue (34.73%), below the >50% threshold.

companies.name: 普天通信集团 / Putian Communication Group Limited
companies.basis: Optical fibers and optical fiber cables were RMB183.91M of RMB700.10M total revenue (26.27%), below the >50% threshold.
companies.source: Putian Communication Group FY2025 Annual Report

companies.name: 飞速创新 / FS.COM Limited
companies.basis: Optical transceivers and fiber connectivity are core product families, but the latest annual report aggregates them into broader networking-solution categories and does not disclose an optical-only percentage sufficient to verify >50%.

companies.name: 环联连讯科技 / Pangaea Connectivity Technology Limited
companies.basis: AI optical connectivity is a major strategic pillar, alongside high-power lasers and next-generation wireless, but the company does not disclose revenue by those pillars, so >50% optical revenue cannot be verified.
